description: This file declares data structures, constants, and function prototypes for converting and processing OMA DRM v1 Forward Lock files, including session management, data conversion, and file mode conversion in pull mode.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_OpenSession
methods.description: Initializes a session for converting a DRM Forward Lock file, returning a session ID and output structure.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_ConvertData
methods.description: Processes input data within a session, producing converted data and handling errors.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_CloseSession
methods.description: Closes a conversion session, finalizing signatures and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: FwdLockConv_ConvertOpenFile
methods.description: Converts a DRM Forward Lock file in pull mode using provided file descriptors and function pointers.
